sources.title: LEGO Ideas 21372 La Catrina boasts some big changes - Brick Fanatics
sources.snippet:
Yop1172’s La Catrina submission has become an official LEGO Ideas set – 21372 La Catrina – which will be available on August 1 for £109.99 / $139.99 / 119.99. Just one look at the fan design and final model, and it’s easy to see that much has changed in development. [...] Now that these same arms are smaller and lighter in 21372 La Catrina, no such struts are needed. This was likely a major component in determining the scale for the set, so as to avoid unsightly supports if possible.

Despite the differences between the fan design and the final model, LEGO Ideas 21372 La Catrina still celebrates the Day of the Dead in the biggest way from the LEGO Group so far. Look forward to picking up this new build from August 1 for £109.99 / $139.99 / €119.99 [...] While the original build stands a staggering 89cm tall, 21372 La Catrina is only 43cm tall. Similarly, that pitched build features 2,894 pieces while the official design has 1,212 elements. Downsizing the build means a more accessible price tag. Unlicensed LEGO sets around 2,900 pieces, such as 21359 Italian Riviera, cost around £249.99 / $299.99 / €279.99.
